plugins.name: localstack
plugins.description: AI skills for developing and testing cloud applications against LocalStack — covering service lifecycle, infrastructure deployment, policy analysis, state management, log analysis, and extensions.

skills.name: localstack-deploy
skills.description: Deploy infrastructure to LocalStack using IaC tools. Use when users want to deploy Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation, SAM, or Pulumi to LocalStack, or need help with the lstk proxy commands (lstk terraform, lstk cdk, lstk sam, lstk aws) or the pulumilocal wrapper.
skills.description_zh: 使用Terraform、CDK、CloudFormation、SAM或Pulumi向LocalStack部署基础设施，并协助使用lstk代理命令及pulumilocal封装。

skills.name: localstack-iam
skills.description: Analyze and enforce IAM policies in LocalStack. Use when users want to enable IAM enforcement, detect permission violations, auto-generate least-privilege policies, or test IAM policies locally before deploying to AWS.
headings: Soft mode - logs violations but allows requests
View IAM-related log entries (-v disables lstk's default log filtering)
skills.description_zh: 在LocalStack分析与执行IAM策略，启用权限约束、检测权限违规、生成最小权限策略，并在部署到AWS前做本地策略测试。

skills.name: localstack-extensions
skills.description: Manage LocalStack Extensions. Use when users want to install, uninstall, list, or configure LocalStack extensions, or develop custom extensions to extend LocalStack functionality. Extensions require the legacy localstack CLI, not lstk.
headings: Extensions are enabled by default after installation
Start LocalStack with the legacy CLI so the extension is loaded
skills.description_zh: 安装、卸载、列出、配置或开发LocalStack扩展；原说明明确扩展需使用旧版localstack CLI而非lstk。

skills.name: localstack
skills.description: Manage the LocalStack emulator lifecycle with the lstk CLI. Use when users need to start, stop, restart, reset, or check status of LocalStack, configure LocalStack environment variables, or troubleshoot LocalStack container issues.
headings: Interactive browser login; stores the token in the system keyring
Start the emulator (bare `lstk` is equivalent to `lstk start`)
Start and keep state across restarts
Start with debug logging (note the LOCALSTACK_ prefix)
Plain output for scripts/CI, with a startup deadline
Emulator state plus the resources currently deployed in it
skills.description_zh: 通过lstk管理LocalStack模拟器的启动、停止、重启、重置与状态，配置环境变量并排查容器问题。

skills.name: localstack-logs
skills.description: Analyze LocalStack logs and debug issues with lstk. Use when users need to view LocalStack logs, debug AWS API errors, troubleshoot Lambda functions, identify error patterns, or enable debug mode.
headings: Unfiltered output (lstk filters noise by default)
Filter by request ID (use -v so nothing is filtered out first)
skills.description_zh: 通过lstk分析LocalStack日志，排查AWS API错误、Lambda函数问题及错误模式，并启用调试模式。

skills.name: localstack-state
skills.description: Manage LocalStack state and snapshots with lstk. Use when users want to save, load, export, or import LocalStack state, work with Cloud Pods or S3-backed snapshots, or enable persistence across restarts.
headings: Save to an auto-named file in the current directory
Save to a specific path (the .snapshot extension is added if omitted)
Limit the snapshot to a subset of services
skills.description_zh: 通过lstk保存、加载、导出或导入LocalStack状态，处理Cloud Pods、S3快照及重启后的持久化。
